reason: Two grand up front before it answers a single call, then 249 a month, is a lot for a one-man shop that already calls people back on breaks. I'd try the demo line, but I wouldn't sign this week.
objection: Paying almost $2,000 setup and still not knowing if a robot taking messages will lose me the customer anyway, because it can't put an urgent call through to me and people in a panic don't want a text back.
would_change_my_mind: Drop or refund the setup fee if it doesn't bring me at least a couple of jobs in the first 60 days, so I'm only risking the monthly.
